WinDV 2.5.1 fixes the main window's remembered size and position.

## Download

- **WinDV-2.5.1-x64-Setup.exe**: the installer for 64-bit Windows (almost every PC).
- **WinDV-2.5.1-x64-portable.zip**: the same app without installing. Unzip anywhere and run `WinDV.exe`.
- **WinDV-2.5.1-x86-Setup.exe** and **WinDV-2.5.1-x86-portable.zip**: the same for 32-bit Windows.

Requires Windows 10 or 11. Your settings from earlier versions (or the original WinDV) carry over.

## Fixed

- **Window placement on multi-monitor setups**: on a system with more than one monitor, WinDV's window could reopen on the wrong monitor, or at the wrong size, especially when the monitors use different display scaling. It now always reopens where you left it.
